mitigation_descriptions: Set and enforce secure password policies for accounts to reduce the likelihood of unauthorized access. Strong password policies include enforcing password complexity, requiring regular password changes, and preventing password reuse.
reasoning: The adversary reviewer confirmed technique T1003.008 involving unauthorized sudo reading of /etc/shadow on host intranet-server by user jward. Immediate containment and credential remediation are required to prevent lateral movement and unauthorized access.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (IP: 192.168.131.215, Agent ID: 21) from the network to contain credential abuse. 2. Terminate any unauthorized sessions and force a password reset for account jward and other accounts exposed in /etc/shadow. 3. Configure Linux Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) using pam_pwquality to enforce complexity and pam_faillock or pam_tally2 for lockout thresholds. 4. Implement pwunconv to manage password reuse controls and audit system security configurations with Lynis.
